headers.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so the bytes behind a URL never change.
The service worker decides what is cached; it must never be cached itself, or a stale worker pins an old app forever.
The pack lives at a stable URL but its contents change with each release, and the app verifies its hash on load. Revalidate rather than serve a stale pack the integrity check would then reject.
Canonical audio is content-addressed by sha256, so a URL is immutable by construction.
The app is local-first: it talks to no third party, so nothing needs to be reachable off-origin.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
